## sminer analyze

Find signals, cluster them into findings, and propose remedies

### Synopsis

Find signals in ingested sessions, confirm them with the classifier, cluster
them into findings, and route each finding to a remedy.

Classifier results are cached, so re-running only classifies new candidates.
--offline skips the classifier and proposal drafting entirely.

```
sminer analyze [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sminer analyze
  sminer analyze --offline --repo ~/src/api --min-count 2
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for analyze
      --min-count int   occurrences a finding needs to be reported (default 3)
      --repo string     only consider sessions in this repository
      --since string    how far back to look: 90d, 2w, 12h (default "90d")
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string   config file (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sminer/config.yaml)
      --db string       database file (default $XDG_DATA_HOME/sminer/sminer.db)
```
